description: Strict per-file allowlist gate that prevents reintroduction of direct tokio, smol, or async-io usage in supported builds, tests, benches, and core docs. Each existing usage must be explicitly quarantined with a named owner and a removal bead. Any file that contains a forbidden token without an explicit allowlist entry fails the gate.

Cargo.toml.reason: Workspace-level tokio dependency declaration; removed when wa-2h1ha (Phase 7) lands.

crates/frankenterm-core/Cargo.toml.reason: frankenterm-core retains tokio for runtime_compat shim; removed when runtime_compat collapses (ft-xbnl0.2.5).

Cargo.toml.reason: Workspace-level smol declaration retained for vendored frankenterm subsystem crates that still use smol primitives.

frankenterm/codec/Cargo.toml.reason: Vendored frankenterm codec crate uses smol for upstream-shaped IO; migration tracked under wa-2h1ha.

frankenterm/lua-api-crates/mux-lua/Cargo.reason: Vendored mux-lua binding inherits smol from upstream; migration tracked under wa-2h1ha.

frankenterm/ssh/Cargo.toml.reason: Vendored frankenterm ssh crate uses smol channels; migration tracked under wa-2h1ha.

Cargo.toml.reason: Workspace-level async-io declaration retained for vendored async_ossl/promise/uds crates.

frankenterm/async_ossl/Cargo.toml.reason: Vendored async_ossl crate wraps OpenSSL on async-io reactor; migration tracked under wa-2h1ha.

frankenterm/promise/Cargo.toml.reason: Vendored promise crate exposes async-io spawn primitives; migration tracked under wa-2h1ha.

frankenterm/uds/Cargo.toml.reason: Vendored uds crate wraps async-io UnixListener; migration tracked under wa-2h1ha.

crates/frankenterm-core/src/runtime_comp.reason: Sole intentional Tokio quarantine root during the asupersync migration (per ft-xbnl0.2.6 design notes). Collapsed by ft-xbnl0.2.5.
Compile-time guard module that names tokio types so its own surface contract test stays meaningful. Removed with runtime_compat under ft-xbnl0.2.5.

crates/frankenterm-core/src/dependency_e.reason: Migration accounting module; tokens are referenced as string literals to track eradication progress, not as runtime calls.

crates/frankenterm-core/src/forbidden_de.reason: Guard module whose purpose is to mention forbidden tokens so its self-test catches their reintroduction.

crates/frankenterm-core/src/manifest_dep.reason: Manifest-eradication audit module; references tokens to encode the guarded set.

crates/frankenterm-core/src/vendored_asy.reason: Contract-verification module for vendored crates; references tokens to encode the guarded set.

crates/frankenterm-core/src/vendored_mig.reason: Vendored migration map; references smol token to track migration of vendored crates.

frankenterm/async_ossl/src/lib.rs.reason: Vendored upstream crate; migrates as part of the vendored crate cleanup phase.

frankenterm/codec/src/lib.rs.reason: Vendored upstream codec; migrates as part of the vendored crate cleanup phase.

frankenterm/promise/src/spawn.rs.reason: Vendored upstream promise crate; migrates as part of the vendored crate cleanup phase.

frankenterm/ssh/src/lib.rs.reason: Vendored upstream ssh crate; migrates as part of the vendored crate cleanup phase.

frankenterm/uds/src/lib.rs.reason: Vendored upstream uds crate; migrates as part of the vendored crate cleanup phase.

test_quarantine_pattern.reason: Lab-runtime tests are explicit Tokio quarantine surface used to validate runtime_compat behavior; migrated en bloc by ft-22x4r.

crates/frankenterm-core/tests/proptest_d.reason: Property tests for the dependency eradication module; references forbidden tokens by name.

crates/frankenterm-core/tests/proptest_f.reason: Property tests for forbidden dependency guards; references forbidden tokens by name.

crates/frankenterm-core/tests/runtime_co.reason: Surface contract test for runtime_compat; closes when runtime_compat collapses.

crates/frankenterm-core/tests/vendored_a.reason: Verifies vendored crates expose expected async contracts; references forbidden tokens by name.

bench_quarantine_pattern.reason: Benchmark harnesses still use #[tokio::test]/tokio::runtime; benchmark migration tracked under ft-xbnl0.4.6 (performance budgets).

docs/COMPREHENSIVE_ANALYSIS_OF_coding_ag.reason: Third-party tool architecture analysis; references the analyzed project's own tokio::main entry point.

docs/adr/0008-query-facade-contract.md.reason: ADR captures migration-era query facade runtime contract; rewritten to native asupersync narrative under ft-xbnl0.5.1 doc sweep.

docs/ftui-pty-fixture-strategy.md.reason: ftui PTY fixture spec contains migration-era code samples; replaced by asupersync samples under ft-xbnl0.5.1 doc sweep.

docs/ftui-subprocess-forwarding-contract.reason: ftui subprocess contract still references tokio::sync::watch as the shutdown signal type; replaced under ft-xbnl0.5.1 doc sweep.

docs/replay-test-taxonomy.md.reason: Replay-test taxonomy mentions #[tokio::test] as the legacy async test convention; replaced under ft-xbnl0.5.1 doc sweep.

docs/timing-determinism.md.reason: Timing-determinism guidance references tokio::time::pause and tokio::time::sleep as both anti-pattern and recommended test primitives; replaced with native asupersync timing primitives under ft-xbnl0.5.1 doc sweep.

doc_narrative_rule.description: Documents under doc_roots may reference forbidden tokens only if they are listed in doc_narrative_allowlist or live under integration-research/ (third-party project analyses).
